text:
olivia: rolling out driver 535.86 -> 536.12 to H100 Dedicated pools, starting canary in us-west1 wave-1 at 09:00 UTC. will drain 10% per rack. cc @sam @diego
sam: ack. what's the rollback trigger threshold? 5% error rate or 30s p95 increase?
diego: prefer two-sided: p95 + error spike. if p95 > baseline + 25% for 10m OR kernel oops count > 3 across canary nodes -> rollback. also watch NCCL timeouts.
jing: adding network-fanout health check to the canary dashboard. will emit alert if nccl peer disconnects > 2 per min.
olivia: note: we also enabling cuda12.3 kernels for model compilation. preflight logs from staging looked clean but one stuck kernel with batch size 8 on sequence=2048. monitoring for any repeat.
sam: schedule looks fine. ops-bot: please run preflight sweep on eu-west1 and ap-southeast1 before wave-2.
ops-bot: preflight sweep queued: eu-west1 -> 1765432400, ap-southeast1 -> 1765433000. will post results.
diego: reminder: Dedicated customers on committed reservations should be excluded from capacity drain unless they opt-in for early updates. need product signoff if we touch reserved pools.
olivia: confirmed - reservable pools excluded. only non-reserved and overflow burst pools in this campaign.
natalie: product here — we need to notify customers in affected regions about ~15m maintenance window and possibility of node replacement. draft notice posted in #customer-announcements, feedback welcome.
sam: good. what about kernel module versions? are we shipping a patched nvidia.ko that changes ABI?
jing: the module has a small API addition for device health telemetry. shouldn't break existing modules, we kept ABI stable. packaging: rpm/deb with postinst that restarts driver service. watching for DKMS mismatches.
diego: add a canary script to verify module signature and modprobe success. if modprobe fails on canary node -> auto rollback and mark rack as quarantined.
olivia: rolling canary now in us-west1 wave-1. 12 nodes drained -> upgraded -> running workloads. initial perf pass: p50/p95 unchanged, small 2% drop in p99 token latency (within noise).
sam: seeing a handful of NCCL timeouts on one rack (rack-17). error logs: "NCCL WARN PeerDisconnect rank 3". looks like a top-of-rack switch retransmit issue.
jing: can you paste the kernel logs?
sam: ```kernel: nvidia: GPU 0: netlink comms lost, peer timeout
kernel: mlx5_core: SANITY check failed on port 2
```
diego: that points to firmware mismatch on the Mellanox NICs after driver reload. maybe the driver triggers different link negotiation. recommend pulling rack-17 from wave and running NIC firmware re-probe.
olivia: pulled rack-17 from canary and kicked rollback on those nodes. currently reassigning workloads to cold spare nodes. 
natalie: customer impact? any affected Dedicated tenants?
olivia: no committed Dedicated tenants impacted; a few burst customers saw ~10-15s connection resets on in-flight requests during failover, but automatic retry handled it.
sam: cost note: extra relational slot usage for spares ~0.6 GPU-hours per failed node; estimate rollout delta cost ~ $120/hr while canary continues. ops budget ok for now.
jing: preflight report for eu-west1: all checks green except one node with DKMS build error on kernel 5.15. marking it as incompatible to avoid wave-2.
diego: action items: 1) update rollout script to exclude racks with older Mellanox FW; 2) push NIC firmware reconciliation job to canary pool; 3) add NCCL peer disconnect alarm to PagerDuty policy for eng-oncall.
olivia: noted. I'll pause wave-2 until firmware job finishes. ETA 3h.
ops-bot: firmware reconciliation job started on canary pool. job id: fw-recon-176543. progress: 0/48 racks.
sam: also add an automated smoke test post-upgrade that runs a short NCCL allreduce across 4 GPUs and verifies bandwidth >= baseline * 0.9. if it fails -> rollback.
jing: implemented smoke test in canary pipeline. results reported to canary dashboard.
diego: once fw-recon done, we do a small staggered wave across two regions (us-west1 + eu-west1) then monitor 30m before global. keep rollback window open for 2 hours after each wave.
olivia: agree. will update runbook and post roll-forward checklist in this thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued for wave-2 pending ops-bot fw-recon success.
